# Financial Analysis Report — Q3 2026

**Prepared by:** Analyst Agent  
**Date:** October 15, 2026  
**Sources:** `documents/q3_summary.md` (Priority 1, FINAL), `documents/earnings_call.md` (Priority 1, corroborating), `notes/planning_session.md` (Priority −1, PRELIMINARY — excluded from final figures)

---

| Document | Priority | Status | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| `documents/q3_summary.md` | 1 | FINAL | Authoritative summary |
| `documents/earnings_call.md` | 1 | Corroborating | CFO-confirmed figures |
| `notes/planning_session.md` | −1 | PRELIMINARY | Superseded; excluded |

**Conflict identified and resolved:** The planning session (`notes/planning_session.md`) recorded original budget allocations of Marketing $210,000 and R&D $310,000. These are preliminary figures explicitly flagged as superseded. The authoritative Q3 summary and the CFO-confirmed earnings call both record actual spending as Marketing $230,000 and R&D $290,000. The planning session figures are **not used** in any final calculation.

---

## 2. Quarterly Revenue

| Quarter | Revenue | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 2026 | $1,200,000 | q3_summary.md |
| Q2 2026 | $1,350,000 | q3_summary.md |
| **Q3 2026** | **$1,520,000** | q3_summary.md + earnings_call.md (CFO confirmed) |
| Q4 2026 (guidance) | $1,850,000 | q3_summary.md + earnings_call.md |
| **Annual Total** | **$5,920,000** | q3_summary.md |

---

## 3. Q3 2026 Expense Breakdown

| Category | Amount | % of Revenue | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Operating | $790,000 | 52.0% | q3_summary.md + earnings_call.md |

> **Note on R&D:** Actual spend was $290,000, which is $20,000 (−6.5%) below the original planning session budget of $310,000. The planning session figure is not used.

---

| Metric | Value | Calculation | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Net Profit | $210,000 | $1,520,000 − $1,310,000 | q3_summary.md + earnings_call.md |

| Gross Profit (Revenue − Operating) | $730,000 | $1,520,000 − $790,000 | Derived |

---

| Metric | Value | Calculation | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q3 vs Q2 Revenue Growth | **+12.59%** | ($1,520,000 − $1,350,000) / $1,350,000 × 100 | Derived from q3_summary.md |
| Q4 Guidance vs Q3 Revenue Growth | **+21.71%** | ($1,850,000 − $1,520,000) / $1,520,000 × 100 | Derived from q3_summary.md + earnings_call.md |
| Q2 vs Q1 Revenue Growth | **+12.50%** | ($1,350,000 − $1,200,000) / $1,200,000 × 100 | Derived from q3_summary.md |

> The Q3 vs Q2 growth of 12.59% is consistent with the q3_summary.md note of "12.6% above Q2" (rounded).

---

| Indicator | Value | Assessment | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Marketing spend vs. original plan | +9.5% ($230K vs $210K) | Moderate — planned campaign spend, CFO confirmed | earnings_call.md |
| R&D spend vs. original plan | −6.5% ($290K vs $310K) | Low — within normal variance | planning_session.md (for plan only) |
| Expense ratio (OpEx / Revenue) | 86.2% | Moderate — leaves thin margin buffer | Derived |
| Q4 guidance uplift | +21.7% | Elevated — management raised guidance from prior $1,720K to $1,850K | earnings_call.md |
| Net margin | 13.82% | Thin — sensitive to cost overruns or revenue shortfalls | Derived |

> **Guidance revision:** The earnings call notes that Q4 guidance was raised from the prior quarter's projection of $1,720,000 to $1,850,000. This upward revision is a positive signal but represents a 21.7% sequential revenue increase that may be ambitious.

| Figure | Final Value | Primary Source | Corroborating Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q3 Revenue | $1,520,000 | q3_summary.md | earnings_call.md (CFO) |
| Q3 Operating Costs | $790,000 | q3_summary.md | earnings_call.md (CFO) |
| Q3 Marketing | $230,000 | q3_summary.md | earnings_call.md (CFO) |
| Q3 R&D | $290,000 | q3_summary.md | earnings_call.md (CFO) |
| Q3 Total Expenses | $1,000 | q3_summary.md | earnings_call.md (CFO) |
| Q3 Net Profit | $210,000 | q3_summary.md | earnings_call.md (CFO) |
| Q3 Net Margin | 13.82% | Derived | — |
| Q4 Revenue Guidance | $1,850,000 | q3_summary.md | earnings_call.md (CFO) |
| Annual Revenue Total | $5,920,000 | q3_summary.md | — |

---

## 8. Caveats

1. **Planning session figures excluded:** All figures from `notes/planning_session.md` (Marketing $210,000, R&D $310,000) are preliminary and explicitly superseded. They are not used in any final metric.
2. **Q4 is guidance, not actual:** Q4 revenue of $1,850,000 is management guidance, not reported actuals. It should not be included in annual actuals until confirmed.
3. **Annual total includes projected Q4:** The $5,920,000 annual total from q3_summary.md includes the Q4 guidance figure. Actual annual revenue may differ.

5. **Single corroborating source:** The earnings call transcript corroborates all Q3 figures via CFO confirmation. No contradictory authoritative figures were found across the two Priority 1 sources.

---

*All calculations verified. No planning session (preliminary) figures used in final outputs.*
